name: Streamex Gold Yield
oneLiner: GLDY is Streamex's tokenized gold ounce on Base, backed by physical bullion and gold-leasing receivables with Chainlink Proof of Reserve.
collateral: Physical gold bullion backing with issuer-managed gold leasing through Monetary Metals; Streamex presents one GLDY as one troy ounce of gold exposure with yield paid in additional gold
pegMechanism: Commodity-backed gold token with Chainlink proof-of-reserves on Base; eligible primary-market investors can redeem through the issuer process, while secondary markets price the gold-ounce claim plus accrued yield mechanics

mintAuthority.summary: GLDY is minted only by the TREASURY_ROLE Safe (2-of-3 multisig), which must satisfy Chainlink PoR reserve backing before minting succeeds. DEFAULT_ADMIN (UUPS upgrade authority) is an issuer EOA. An OPERATOR_ROLE Safe (2-of-3) handles pausing and whitelist management.

controls.label: GLDY TREASURY_ROLE Safe (direct minter)
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200691, GLDY (0x632db1...) hasRole(TREASURY_ROLE, 0x655f31f9136d54bc319c00dd43009104646b0951) = true. Blockscout confirms 0x655f31... is SafeL2. getOwners() = 3; getThreshold() = 2; getModulesPaginated() = sentinel only (no modules). GLDYTokenERC20.mint() requires TREASURY_ROLE and passes reserve check (reserves >= newSupply via Chainlink PoR).

controls.label: GLDY DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA (UUPS upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200691, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x9625c15f7b305680c1690cd41103870e2050028d) = true; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). DEFAULT_ADMIN controls _authorizeUpgrade() only; role admin for TREASURY_ROLE and OPERATOR_ROLE is also DEFAULT_ADMIN.

review.evidence: At Base block 47200691: GLDYProxy (ERC1967, UUPS) → GLDYTokenERC20 implementation. TREASURY_ROLE = 2-of-3 Safe 0x655f31... (SafeL2, no modules); minting gated on reserve check. OPERATOR_ROLE = 2-of-3 Safe 0xe46c4b... (SafeL2, no modules). DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0x9625c1... (controls upgrade only). No permissionless mint. Chainlink PoR enforces 1:1 reserve backing before mint completes.
